Welcome to my online portfolio for Intermediate Data Science (Comp/Stat 212), a course taken at [Macalester College](https://www.macalester.edu/).  Please use the side bar on the left for navigation.

```{r}
#| output: false
#| echo: false

packages <- c("wordcloud2", "here")
```

```{r}
#| output: false
#| echo: false

install.packages(setdiff(packages, rownames(installed.packages())), repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")
```

```{r}
#| output: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false

lapply(packages, require, character.only = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
#| echo: false

ds <- read.csv(here("assets", "msg.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

wordcloud2(data = ds, shape = "cardioid", fontFamily = "helvetica neue")

# alt color vector: color = c("skyblue4", "lightsteelblue2", "thistle3", "wheat3", "darkolivegreen4", "sienna4", "lightsalmon3", "lavenderblush4")
```
